rows.title: use Contextmanagers to handle StopIteration in generators

outcomes.text: The new @contextmanager decorator requires an import. Add `from contextlib import contextmanager` to the imports at the top of the file.
The return type hint of `_runtest_for` should reflect that it is now a context manager, e.g. `-> ContextManager[None]` (imported from `typing`).

rows.title: terminal: notify terminal emulator about test session progress

outcomes.text: The `_emit_progress` method uses `Literal` in its type annotation but `Literal` is not imported. Add `from typing import Literal` to the imports at the top of the file.

The new `reported_progress` property accesses `self._progress_nodeids_reported`, which is a set. The property returns its length, but the docstring says "The amount of items reported in the progress so far." Consider renaming to `reported_progress_count` or clarifying that it returns a count, not the set itself.
The tests patch `sys.stdout.isatty` but `sys` is never imported. Add `import sys` to the imports.
`Literal` is imported but never used in this file. Remove the unused import to keep the test module clean.
The `mock_tr` fixture is annotated as returning `pytest.TerminalReporter`, which does not exist. It should be `TerminalReporter` imported from `_pytest.terminal`.
`Mock(spec=pytest.TerminalReporter)` uses the same incorrect reference. Change the spec to `TerminalReporter` (the class imported from `_pytest.terminal`).
